item.title: Murkowski opposes Blanche, jeopardizing confirmation
item.description: Sen. Lisa Murkowski (R-Alaska) announced Friday she will vote against Todd Blanche's confirmation as attorney general, potentially blocking it with two GOP holdouts.

item.title: Rubio's aggressive Cuba strategy leaves no room for retreat
item.description: Secretary of State Marco Rubio is intensifying economic pressure on Cuba, signaling to its communist government that the campaign will persist.

item.title: GOP to host anti-socialism telethon at midterm convention
item.description: Republicans will use their first midterm convention in Dallas to argue that Democrats have embraced socialism, in a prime-time presentation.

item.title: AI deepfake regulations vary widely across states
item.description: Americans may encounter inconsistent AI deepfake protections during elections, as state laws differ significantly, according to NCSL data.
